headline: AWS Cloud Engineer | DevOps, Infrastructure Automation, and Platform Migration
summary_html: AWS Cloud Engineer with 10+ years of experience delivering cloud infrastructure, automation, and migration work across AWS and hybrid environments. Strong background in Terraform, CloudFormation, VPC networking, IAM, Route 53, ALB/NLB, CloudWatch, EKS, and CI/CD automation, with hands-on experience supporting environment transitions across multi-account AWS estates, Kubernetes platforms, and enterprise application portfolios. Known for turning infrastructure requirements into practical AWS designs, documenting architecture and operational standards clearly, and partnering with engineering and application teams to keep migration efforts technically sound and operationally ready.

achievements.text: Built reusable Terraform and CloudFormation patterns to standardize AWS infrastructure provisioning across accounts, environments, and delivery stages.
Designed and supported EKS-based platforms for containerized services, including cluster provisioning, Helm-based deployments, and environment-specific configuration management.
Built and improved CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and AWS-native automation, embedding validation, scanning, secrets handling, and controlled release gates.
Improved operational visibility and release support through CloudWatch, ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, and runbook-driven incident response practices.
Helped align source and target environments by resolving differences in networking, IAM, logging, deployment workflows, and system-agent behavior during migration work.

experience.title: Lead DevOps Engineer

Implemented secure connectivity patterns with VPC endpoints and PrivateLink to protect application traffic during modernization and migration efforts.
Embedded DevSecOps controls into infrastructure delivery by enforcing Terraform validation, secure secrets handling, gated approvals, and pre-deployment policy checks across AWS environments.
Worked with engineering and application teams to reconcile access models, deployment tooling, runtime dependencies, and operational telemetry as workloads moved into AWS environments.
Automated operational workflows with Python, Bash, and PowerShell to reduce manual intervention during provisioning, deployments, and migration support tasks.

Led technical working sessions with engineering and application teams to resolve implementation dependencies, sequence rollout activities, and align migration execution plans.
